response.overview: A work about depression, caring for the mental health of people around is a very important thing, this animation tells the psychological journey of a girl, the story is not true, but it may be true!  In the past two years, I have been involved in mental health treatment in the hospital by means of art therapy. This film tells the story of a patient, who witnessed her recovery and bravely faced the disease.  The mental health hospital is the place I have visited most in the past three years. It is not to treat myself, but to help doctors treat depression patients with art. I formed a band with them and performed impromptu.
response.title: Stand up again
